a: VLBI time at 6.7, 22 and 43 GHz on up to 13 telescopes (KaVA, Nobeyama 45 m, Takahagi, Hitachi, Yamaguchi, Sejong); up to 500 hours in total for 2027A. Chinese telescopes do not take part in 2027A. No funding.
dt: Deadline Mon 2 Nov 2026, 08:00 UT; submission via the EAVN website opened 1 Oct 2026. Observations 16 Jan to 15 Jun 2027.
e: Open-use call for VLBI observations with the East Asian VLBI Network. The EAVN status report says the open-use call is for astronomers in the world; proposers new to EAVN are advised to include an EAVN collaborator.
n: East Asian VLBI Network (EAVN) Semester 2027A Call for Proposals
unv: Graduate-student PI eligibility is not stated.
